source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: The bearer gives **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** to the ranged weapons of every model in any unit it is leading. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.while: the bearer is leading a unit
effects.appliesTo: ranged weapons of models in that unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Anvil Siege Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
